notes.title: Notice of cessation of development and publication
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for your continued patronage. We regret to inform you that we will be discontinuing service for this game on **Tuesday, October 21st, 2025**. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has used the game so far, and we deeply apologize for the sudden announcement. We hope you will enjoy the game until the end, even though there is only a short time left. We look forward to your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Ver1.11 It is now possible for players to interrupt during CPU battles.
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing.
We have updated the following

Players can now intrude during CPU battles.
When you check the “Allow player intrusion” checkbox for CPU Single Battle and start the game,
You will be matched with a player who is waiting for a Single Battle or playing a CPU Single Battle.
For CPU Multibattle,
You will be matched with a player who is waiting for a player in a CPU Multibattle or a player who is playing a CPU Multibattle in a mode where his or her teammate is the CPU.

Rare tickets can now be obtained by turning the Coin Gasha three times.
∙ Changed some of the UI of item details (can be reverted in the options)

Thank you for your continued support of Retsubato!

notes.title: Implementation of CPU battles in multi-battles! Balance adjustment of many equip
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!
We have updated the following contents.

CPU battles in multi-battles have been implemented.
You can fight against CPU in multi-battle. There are two types of modes: one in which allies are CPUs, and the other in which players are allies (there are Random Match and Aikouji Match).
In the mode where the CPU is your ally, you can choose between "close range type," "long range type," and "support type" allies.
The difficulty level is challenging from about stage 30, so please play with your friends and carefully select your equipment!


Training mode has been implemented.
This is a mode in which the opponent does not attack. Use it to check your equipment.
PC version only,
Y:Dash
U:Special 1
I: Special 2
O:Weapon1
P:Weapon2
P:Weapon2

Equipment modification and special ability addition
1. added special abilities
Blind: Hit rate is greatly reduced by one-third.
Slip: Increased susceptibility to being blown up.
All Cure: Heal all abnormalities only once.
2. equipment modifications.
We have slightly weakened some equipment that was too strong and strengthened some equipment that was not used.
Added special abilities to most unused equipment to make it more unique.
Some specials are now treated as melee attacks and cannot be blocked by barriers. (Special ability: melee has been added).

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: ver1.03 Enhancement of short-range weapons, etc.
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing.
The following updates have been made.
Increased the attack range of melee weapons and added effects.
The range of melee weapons used to be very narrow and difficult to use, but we have greatly increased the range and made them easier to use.
The stage has been widened, the blow-off rate has been adjusted, and the dash has been weakened.
The battle used to end quickly with a dash tackle, but we have made it more important to use specials and weapons.
Bug Fixes
Bug that Death is reflected across rounds.
UR gacha bug: items other than unacquired items were showing up.
Gachas no longer refer to maximum MP
The Gasha lineup changes according to the maximum MP, so rare items were not available in the early stages of the game, but now they are.

We report updates on Twitter. Please follow us if you like.
https://twitter.com/retubato

We are planning to implement a CPU battle in the next update!
Please look forward to it!

notes.title: Official release on March 15, 5:00 p.m!
notes.notes:
We will officially release the game on March 15 at 5:00 pm!

Basic play is free, so please play!
You can also battle with your friends, so we hope you will invite your friends to join us.
Android and iOS versions will be released at the same time.
You can play with people on all platforms!
